source.title: SWE Common Data Model Encoding Standard

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: Describes an ordered logical record of uniquely named and typed fields, including scalars, aggregate components, and a referenced semantic definition.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A DataRecord field descriptor may represent a reported output field; it is NOT an addressed physical channel, proof of an emitted value, or identical to a CSAPI DataStream.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: A data component's definition denotes the property its value represents using a controlled vocabulary/registry/ontology, often an observed property.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A definition URI relates a value to property semantics; it is NOT itself an ontology class instance, a physical sensing unit, or an actual performed Observation.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: A categorical field's code space or enumerated tokens can define value choices; a camera operating mode is an explicit example in §7.2.2.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A permitted token vocabulary is not necessarily a source-attested operating-mode capability list for an individual device, and does not establish which mode is active.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: A Category component can carry a single value from a constrained code space (e.g., a mode/status code) in an encoded data block.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Encoding a mode string does not prove that an individual System reported that value, nor furnish report time, issuer, or actual effective mode.

sourceNativeHolds.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Numeric value and semantic unit/scale are representable; °C, humidity ratios and ppm must keep explicit native units. This does not itself add a DIM field/value schema or a real observation.

sourceNativeHolds.term: Time and TimeRange; temporal reference frame
sourceNativeHolds.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Can encode instants or two inclusive bounds, not automatically the original NOAA phenomenonTime/resultTime semantics or an actually known observation-generation timestamp.
Can model measured-value quality using numeric, categorical, textual or interval components, but not silently normalize Bennett literal F_ATemp='<0> ' or combine separate F_Record field.
Can declare a missing-value token with reason; does not authorize converting blank source flags to valid zero measurements or reversing original type/lexical form.
Can define rated or allowed electrical ranges, but manufacturer voltage or battery design range is not measured remaining charge or condition.
Defines a data-stream payload descriptor; NOT the CSAPI resource identity, transport path, LoRaWAN FPort, MQTT topic, collection schedule or real measured stream.
Array records/values are repeated typed data, not one distinct physical transducer per array element; a calibration table can be encoded but a calibration curve must still be interpreted.
Describes a changeable input/parameter in some process contexts; does not by itself describe issued, authenticated, acknowledged or completed Command.
Optional identifier for a DATA COMPONENT, not a persistent CSAPI System uniqueIdentifier or manufactured hardware serial.
Can represent logger or station status values with explicit semantics, not prove actual system health or transform PanelTemp into outdoor air temperature.
Optional JSON members and null need descriptor context; missing field/value, missing original event, and numerical zero are different things.

Normative Req85(A) says recordsAsArrays=true encodes objects, conflicting with §8.7.1 and §10.2.3 narrative (true switches to arrays). Preserve as suspected document inconsistency; do not silently choose contradictory rule for implementation.
Can carry spatial coordinates with a CRS, but station/site coordinates cannot be assigned to each unsurveyed probe.

sourceEditorialAmbiguity: OGC 24-014 Requirement 85(A) recordsAsArrays polarity apparently contradicts §8.7.1 and §10.2.3 prose; record as editorial ambiguity pending authoritative clarification
excluded: No merging source methods with Observations, nor SML/CSAPI System identity with data components
No SWE Common original event/issuer/history guarantee
No JSON producer conformance/Glaux running code test
